title: Height of a binary search tree
prompt: The input is a list of integers. Insert the values one by one, in order, into a binary search tree: a value less than a node's value goes into its left subtree, a value greater than it goes into its right subtree, and a value equal to a node's value is not inserted again. Output the height of the tree: the number of nodes on the longest path from the root down to a leaf. An empty tree has height 0, and a single node has height 1.
